newsitem.title: EGYPT: Australia's trade minister visits Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Australia's trade minister visits Egypt.

text.p: Australia's Trade Minister Tim Fischer arrived in Egypt on Saturday for talks on trade between the two countries.
Airport sources reported the arrival of Fischer, who travelled from Kuwait where he lobbied for an Australian company bidding for a contract in Kuwait for helicopter-carrying missile vessels.

Fischer, who is also deputy prime minister, is expected to hold talks with Egyptian businessmen and officials to increase commercial ties, not only in Australian exports of wheat to Egypt but also in advanced technology, an Australian embassy statement said.
Fischer's tour of the Middle East includes Lebanon, Jordan, Israel, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, and he will hold talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in Gaza, it said.
